Create a box plot

Source: R/box_plot.R
box_plot.Rd

Draws one box and whiskers per group: the box spans the first to the third quartile, the thick line is the median, the whiskers reach the most extreme values within 1.5 times the interquartile range, and the points beyond them are drawn as outliers. The quartiles are computed in R (stats::quantile(), type 7), so they match boxplot() and ggplot2::geom_boxplot().

Usage

box_plot(
  data,
  y,
  group = NULL,
  horizontal = FALSE,
  points = c("outliers", "all", "none"),
  notch = FALSE,
  mean = TRUE,
  sort = c("none", "median", "mean"),
  colors = NULL,
  box_width = 0.6,
  point_radius = 3,
  value_format = ",.2~f",
  x_title = NULL,
  y_title = NULL,
  axis_title_font_size = 12,
  x_font_size = 11,
  y_font_size = 11,
  hover = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  title_font_size = 16,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  text_col = "#333333",
  grid_col = "#ececec",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

y

The name of the numeric column to summarise.

group

Optional. The name of a column that splits the data into boxes. Factor levels give the order.

horizontal

Logical. Draw horizontal boxes. Defaults to FALSE.

points

Which points to draw: "outliers" (the default), "all" (every observation, jittered over the box) or "none".

notch

Logical. Draw notches around the median (roughly a 95 percent interval for it). Defaults to FALSE.

mean

Logical. Mark the mean with a diamond. Defaults to TRUE.

sort

How to order the boxes: "none" (the default), "median" or "mean" (ascending).

colors

Optional. Colours of the boxes: one colour, one per group, or a named vector matched to the groups.

box_width

The width of the boxes, as a share of the space of each group (between 0.1 and 1). Defaults to 0.6.

point_radius

The radius of the points in pixels. Defaults to 3.

value_format

A d3 format for the values in the tooltips. Defaults to ",.2~f".

x_title, y_title

Optional. The titles of the axes. By default the value axis is titled with y and the group axis with group.

axis_title_font_size

The font size of the axis titles. Defaults to 12.

x_font_size, y_font_size

The font sizes of the tick labels. Default to 11.

hover

Logical. Show tooltips and highlight on hover. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Grow the boxes when the chart is drawn. Defaults to TRUE.

title

Optional. The title of the chart.

title_font_size

The font size of the title. Defaults to 16.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

text_col

The colour of the text and the axes. Defaults to "#333333".

grid_col

The colour of the grid lines; NULL for none. Defaults to "#ececec".

width, height

Optional. The size of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

Hover a box to see its summary (count, quartiles, mean, whiskers and number of outliers) while the other boxes fade, and hover a point to see its value. The boxes grow from their median when the chart is drawn. Inside Shiny, clicking a box sets input$<id>_clicked to a list with the group and its summary.

Examples

box_plot(iris, y = "Sepal.Length", group = "Species", title = "Sepal length")



box_plot(
  mtcars,
  y = "mpg",
  group = "cyl",
  points = "all",
  notch = TRUE,
  colors = c("#4269d0", "#efb118", "#ff725c"),
  y_title = "Miles per gallon",
  x_title = "Cylinders"
)



box_plot(
  ToothGrowth,
  y = "len",
  group = "dose",
  horizontal = TRUE,
  sort = "median",
  title = "Tooth length by dose"
)
